        return "Not a valid rectangle"
    
    # Calculate rectangle boundaries
    r1_left = x1 - w1/2
    r1_right = x1 + w1/2
    r1_top = y1 + h1/2
    r1_bottom = y1 - h1/2
    
    r2_left = x2 - w2/2
